# testing_x_entity_one_of (Resource)

XEntityOneOf Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_entity_one_of" "my_xentityoneof" {
  branch_two = {
    branch_two_config = "...my_branch_two_config..."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `branch_one` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branch_one))
- `branch_two` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branch_two))

### Read-Only

- `config` (String) Free-form server-computed config shared across oneOf branches. Parsed as JSON.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `shared_name` (String) Shared name property across oneOf branches

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_x_entity_one_of.my_testing_x_entity_one_of
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_x_entity_one_of.my_testing_x_entity_one_of "..."
```
